source: Build CD Balance and Endorsements pages from Figma

assumptions.text: Positive values and success states use Compass primary purple as approved because Compass has no dedicated green success token.
Figma illustration nodes were unavailable, so action and balance artwork uses approved lucide-react icons inside Compass components.
Visible Figma transaction values are represented as static sample data.
Filters and sorting are interactive against local sample data; report, action, view-file, and download controls are presentational until backend flows are supplied.
Desktop card grids stack responsively on narrow screens while wide tables remain horizontally scrollable.
